contexts.text: He was against all whom he could dexterously... refute and vituperate. SE 3485.
They use many arts to infuse weariness and consequent weakness, especially vituperations and defamations.
He then makes [evils] allowable... such as... vituperations...
(Those in the love of self) not only despise others... but also pursue them with censures ... AC 9348:7.
a. [5]. There was one who accounted it as nothing to vituperate others: I heard his vituperations enumerated in order...
If women were to court (men) they would not only be censured...
If they honour Divine things, it is only lest they be... censured.
He vituperated him from whom he could not gain anything.
They do not appear proud in the external form... for, when vituperated... they cared nothing...
The vituperation of doctrine from the natural man. Signified.
